name: Project Reset
source:
Play as a boy who got back from a 1 month vacation and has returned to school, only to find that he meets 3 new friends, and gets into a new hobby!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/914510/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演一个度假1个月后回到学校的男孩，却发现自己结识了3位新朋友，并培养出一项新兴趣！

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/914510/]Steam[/url]]
